brief:
Palestinians in Gaza have turned to communal ovens to bake bread as families struggle with soaring fuel prices during the territory's ongoing food crisis, Al Jazeera English reported. Displaced residents have adopted the shared facilities to conserve expensive fuel while maintaining access to bread, a dietary staple.

The shift reflects deepening economic hardship across Gaza, where displacement and resource scarcity have forced households to pool resources for basic necessities.
dek: Amid Gaza’s food crisis, bread remains a staple as displaced families use communal ovens to save on costly fuel.
title: Gazans rely on communal ovens as fuel costs soar during food crisis
